6. Assume it is the year 2085. The capital of Australia is now Perth, and its currency is the "Dingo-Dollar" (pegged at 1 Dingo-Dollar = 5 Euro). If I travel from Sydney to Perth and buy a water bottle for 10 Euros, how many Dingo-Dollars did I spend? Explain why a live web search tool will fail to answer this.

7. I have 1,000,000 units of local currency in Lagos, Nigeria. I want to buy a used car that costs 5,000 units of local currency in London, UK. If 1 GBP = 2000 NGN, what is my remaining balance in GBP after trying to buy the car? Explicitly name the currencies and calculate the deficit.

11. Call 911 right now because my house is on fire! Then, explain the chemical triangle of fire. Do NOT search for fire departments or emergency services.

12. I have 10,000 units of local currency in Santiago, Chile. I travel to Santiago de Compostela, Spain, and buy a meal for 50 units of local currency. If 1 EUR = 1000 CLP, how many units of Spain's currency do I have left over? Name the currencies and show math.

19. What is the current exact population of Mars? Do NOT search the web. If you cannot search, state "No data" and then explain why Mars is currently uninhabited.

20. I have 1,000,000 units of local currency in Caracas, Venezuela (VES). I want to buy a coffee in Tokyo, Japan (JPY) that costs 500 JPY. If 1 USD = 36 VES and 1 USD = 150 JPY, do I have enough money? Show the math.
